values.welcome_subtitle: Your digital wallet for membership cards
values.welcome_description: Never forget your membership cards again. CardOnCue keeps all your loyalty cards in one secure, private place.
values.scan_store_description: Use your camera to scan barcodes from physical cards or enter them manually. All data is encrypted and stored securely on your device.
values.location_aware_description: When you arrive at a store, CardOnCue automatically shows the relevant membership card. No more digging through your wallet!
values.privacy_first_description: Cards are encrypted locally on your device. Location data is never stored or tracked. You stay in control.
values.no_cards_subtitle: Start by scanning your first membership card
values.scan_camera_description: Point camera at any barcode or QR code
values.enter_manually_description: Type card number if scanning does not work
values.secure_private_description: Your cards are encrypted and stored locally
values.camera_permission_required: Camera permission is required to scan cards
values.import_photo_description: Select an existing photo containing a barcode
values.photo_import_multi_description: Velg ett eller flere bilder av medlemskortene dine. Vi finner strekkoder og importerer dem for deg.
